_comment: Chapter 1 of the story revamp (docs/gameplay/23 §4): F04, a choice: spare the hungry soldier (mercy) or threaten him (vengeance); he comes back in chapter 5.

text.zh_TW: 角落裡縮著一個年輕的灰面具士兵，面具歪了，肚子咕咕叫。「別、別殺我……我是被抓來當兵的……」
text.en: A young grey-mask soldier cowers in the corner, mask askew, stomach growling. "D-don't kill me... they made me join..."

label.zh_TW: （分他半塊麵包）「走吧，別再回來。」
label.en: (Share half your bread) "Go. Don't come back."
"Talk! Where did they take my parents!"

text.zh_TW: 士兵愣住了。「你……謝謝。」他壓低聲音：「灰面在五層等你。他知道你會來。」說完他就逃走了。
text.en: The soldier stares. "You... thank you." He lowers his voice. "Grey Mask is waiting on the fifth floor. He knows you're coming." Then he runs.

text.zh_TW: 士兵發抖：「最、最上面！給『主人』的！灰面在五層等你……求求你放過我！」他連滾帶爬地逃了。
text.en: The soldier shakes. "The t-top! For 'the Master'! Grey Mask is waiting on the fifth floor... please let me go!" He scrambles away.
